title: Traffic-light town · Level 3: Across town
brief: The colour robot starts in a 300 x 300 mm start box on the north street of a town loop (starts vary 15 mm and 3 degrees); the level fixes the robot. The loop is four white streets 300 mm wide whose outer edges make a 2400 x 1800 mm rectangle, driven clockwise from the start: east along the north street, south along the east street, west along the south street. A yellow 100 x 100 mm turn sign in the middle of the north-east junction, and another in the middle of the south-east junction, each mean turn right. Three traffic lights, 150 x 300 mm patches across the street, one on each street of the route, are painted red or green, changing every 4 s, each starting at a moment new every run. The school, a blue 300 x 300 mm zone, is on the south street at the route's end. The town is new every run: the first sign's middle is 550 to 850 mm ahead of the start, the school's middle 550 to 1750 mm past the second sign's, and each light at a place new every run on its street, between the start box, the junctions and the school. A run ends once the program has ended and the robot has then stood still for 0.5 s, or at 120 s. A robot whose colour sensor leaves a light on the far side while it is red has run a red light: that run scores 0. A run finishes when the robot stops with its middle in the school, having driven through every light, without running a red light. Per run: 50 for finishing, plus up to 40 for speed on the driving time (the run's time less the time the robot stood still; all 40 at par or less, 40 x par / driving time above it), both paid only on a finish; plus 10 if at every stop on a red light the colour sensor was short of the light's middle line. Pass: mean 60 or more over 5 runs, 4 of them finished. Par time: 1 s for every 150 mm of the route, measured along the streets' middle from the start to the school's middle (17 to 27 s; the run table's toSign and toSchool give each run's route: toSign + 1500 + toSchool).

score.run: let par = (toSign + 1500 + toSchool) / 150 in round(if(redRun, 0, if(stopped & inSchool & lightsCrossed == 3, 50 + 40 * min(1, par / max(driveS, 0.001)), 0) + if(redStopPast == 0, 10, 0)), 1)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.stopped & r.inSchool & !r.redRun & r.lightsCrossed == 3)
